ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens if you want to link directly to this section from elsewhere on the page.

SectionHeading.helper: Required. This is the main heading shown for the section. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed if needed.
SectionHeading.placeholder: Measurable outcomes for the human ecosystem.

Image.helper: Required. Use a strong vertical or portrait-leaning image. Recommended minimum size: 1400px wide by 1750px tall for the best crop and clarity.

ValuePropositions.helper: Add as many items as you want, but this template will only display the first 3 in the order shown here.

Title.helper: Required. Short title for this value proposition. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.

Description.helper: Required. Keep this to a few short sentences for the best layout. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.
Description.placeholder: Reducing directed attention fatigue through soft fascination, restoring the group’s capacity for focus and problem-solving.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.
